parsed.post: Discarding the last run (0.8839); it regressed from my best (0.8740). The reduction in batch size to 131072 might have made individual gradient updates too noisy or too small for the 5-minute window. Reverting to TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144. Next, I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if slightly more aggressive learning helps.
parsed.description: Revert batch size to 262144 and increase MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to find a better balance between step count and stability.
